senses.definition: n.m. loan;—only cstr. שָׁמוֹט כָּל־בַּעַל מַשֵּׁה יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַשֶּׁה בְּרֵעֵהוּ Dt 15:2 every possessor of a loan of his hand shall renounce what he lends to his neighbour (cf. Dr).
